T:P2.2.text: Smart Sand Industrial Product Solutions At SmartSand, we proudly own and operate four premium northern white sand mines, spanning from the St. Peter to the Wonewoc formations. Our extensive product range, from 8/16 to 100GFN, ensures

T:P2.4.text: At SmartSand, we proudly own and operate four premium northern white sand mines, spanning from the St. Peter to the Wonewoc formations. Our extensive product range, from 8/16 to 100GFN, ensures we meet all your sand needs.

T:P2.5.text: Diverse Product Selection: From coarse to fine grains, we have it all.

T:P2.6.text: Extensive Shipping Network: With access to 6 railroads, we deliver across the USA, Canada, and Mexico.

T:P2.7.text: Flexible Loading and Shipping Options: We offer loading and shipping via “Bulk bag, 3000#”, high-speed truck loading for both pneumatic and bottom dump, and bulk shipping via rail.

T:P2.8.text: Custom Solutions: Offering custom blending and in-house packaging to suit your specific requirements.

T:P2.9.text: SmartSand is dedicated to the industrial market, ensuring a consistent, long-term supply of high-quality sand at competitive prices. Our industrial team, boasting over 100 years of combined experience, is committed to providing exceptional products to markets worldwide. Utilizing in-house state of the art technology for gradation, ADV, pH, LOI, Moisture, and XRF (Powder/Pellet).

T:P2.10.text: Our rapid expansion is a testament to our strategic commitment and the trust our customers place in us. Partnering with SmartSand means discovering a new way of doing business, one that sets you apart from the competition.

C:P1.2.text: Leading manufacturer of pressure control equipment used during drilling, completion and production operations onshore and offshore. Headquartered in Houston, Tx.

C:P1.3.text: Leading the Oil & Gas Industry in Execution Excellence

C:P1.4.text: Cactus Wellhead™ manufactures and services pressure control equipment for onshore and offshore oil and gas drilling, completion and production. Our experience is unparalleled. Key managers have not only accumulated decades of knowledge in the industry but have also worked together as a team for an average of 25 years. As a company, our roots go back 50 years and three generations.

C:P1.5.text: faster, safer and more productive solutions

C:P1.7.text: Cactus™ SafeDrill ® Wellhead Systems include a complete line of drill-through single piece multi-bowl wellhead systems that enhance field personnel safety and save valuable rig time. These efficient and innovative systems, with a straight bore design and lock ring technology, are safer, easier and faster to install than conventional wellhead systems and maximize the benefits of pad drilling.

C:P1.9.text: Cactus Wellhead™ has the quality products and the experienced service technicians to assure that your frac job will be completed without surprises.

C:P1.10.text: Cactus Wellhead™ manufactures and services pressure control equipment for onshore and offshore oil and gas drilling, completion and production.

C:P1.11.text: Cactus Wellhead™ products and systems are designed and manufactured to the highest industry standards. We have implemented a fully documented API Spec 6A and Q1/ISO 9001:2015 quality management system that supports our state-of-the-art manufacturing facilities. Hands-on involvement and communication by branch operations, installation crews and manufacturing facilities ensure that Cactus Wellhead™ is fully committed to quality excellence and reduction of risk.

C:P1.13.text: Cactus Wellhead™, through a formal and comprehensive company-wide HSE management program, fulfills its commitment for the well-being and protection of individuals at all field and company locations. We establish and adhere to our own strict safety standards as well as those of our valued customers.
